commit_scope: The kernel steward's launchd tick keeps the host's seed kernel checkout on main (fast-forward only, only when clean) and lets the door's own errors reach its log; observed live after install.
evidence_refs: Observed 2026-10-19: ~/source/coherence-kernel had no puller any more (com.coherence-network.runner sits disabled, launchd knows no such service) and stood seven commits behind origin/main, so the first steward tick found no observe/kernel-steward-run.bml; its error went to /dev/null.

The tick now fast-forwards the checkout only when `git status --porcelain` is empty (a dirty tree is left untouched; a fast-forward never rewrites work), rebuilds fkwu when runtime/fkwu-uni.c is newer, and lets stderr reach the launchd error log (organ-health lines filtered).

After reinstall the first tick logged: [kernels] 11 running; orphans 0 (stopped 0); heavy without a lease 0; leased 1; glass published — and receipts/kernel-steward-ledger.jsonl in the seed checkout carries the row {kernels:11, orphans:0, heavy:0, leased:1, stopped:0, mode:act}.
The kernel organ itself landed as coherence-kernel PR 611 (band 15); the scheduled walks call ks-tend(1) in their heal stage.

local_validation.summary: bash -n on the script; launchd service com.coherence.kernel-steward bootstrapped and its first tick observed in ~/Library/Logs/CoherenceSense/kernel-steward.log.

ci_validation.summary: A host launchd carrier has no CI surface; CI is unchanged by this commit.

deploy_validation.summary: Installed on the authoring Mac by hand (bash scripts/install_kernel_steward.sh); no production deploy phase.

e2e_validation.expected_behavior_delta: Every two minutes the host's kernels are read; an orphan (source file gone) is stopped; the seed checkout follows main.

phase_gate.blocked_reason: Host-only carrier: there is no CI or production deploy phase to pass; the live observation is the launchd log.
